blocks.text: Electrons ki wave nature ka pakka proof (saboot) Clinton J. Davisson aur Lester H. Germer ne diya. Unhon ne dikhaya ke electrons metal crystals se bilkul X-rays (ya kisi aur wave) ki tarah diffract hote hain. Un ka apparatus Fig. 18.7 mein hai: garam filament se nikle electrons ko ek adjustable (badla ja sakne wale) voltage se accelerate (tez) kiya jata hai aur yeh beam nickel crystal par dali jati hai. Metal ki surface (satah) se scattered (bikhre) electrons regular peaks (chotiyon) mein nikle. Unhon ne in peaks ko diffraction ka result samjha, bilkul NaCl crystal se X-rays ke diffraction ki tarah. Electrons ki waves ki wavelength bilkul utni hi nikli jitni de Broglie ne batayi thi.

blocks.alt: Garam filament wali electron gun apni beam neeche nickel crystal par dalti hai. Crystal se dashed line mude hue scale par sarakne wale detector tak jati hai; incident aur scattered beam ke darmiyan angle phi hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.7: electron diffraction ke liye Davisson aur Germer ka experimental arrangement (kitab ki Figure 18.7 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Germer ka naam 'Laster H. Germer' chhapti hai; sahi naam Lester H. Germer hai. Kitab de Broglie ko yahan 'de Brogalie' bhi likhti hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Detector ko scale par ghuma kar har angle φ par scattered electrons ka current napa jata hai. Kuch khaas angles par current ke peaks (chotiyan) milte hain, bilkul X-rays ke diffraction ki tarah; yeh electrons ki wave nature ka proof hai.

Energy Ve wali electron beam nickel crystal par parti hai. Crystal ki surface se diffract hui beam detector mein jati hai aur current I ki shakal mein record hoti hai. Electron gun mein potential V se accelerate (tez) hone par electron ki K.E. mein increase (izafa):

blocks.text_alt: From de Broglie equation: λ = h/mv

blocks.text: Ek experiment mein accelerating voltage V = 54 volts tha, is liye:
Crystal ki surface se diffract hui electrons ki beam 65° ke glancing angle par mili. Bragg's equation ke mutabiq:

blocks.text_alt: Thus 2 × 0.91 × 10⁻¹⁰ m × sin 65° = λ, which gives

blocks.text: Yani experiment (Bragg) se napi gayi wavelength (1.65 × 10⁻¹⁰ m) theory (de Broglie) se nikali gayi wavelength (1.66 × 10⁻¹⁰ m) se taqreeban bilkul mil gayi.

blocks.title: Hisaab check karein
blocks.text: In values se poora hisaab: 2 × 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ × 54 × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ = 1.57 × 10⁻⁴⁷, is ka square root 3.97 × 10⁻²⁴, aur λ = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ ÷ 3.97 × 10⁻²⁴ = 1.67 × 10⁻¹⁰ m. Kitab 1.66 × 10⁻¹⁰ m likhti hai; yeh rounding (gol karne) ka chhota sa farq hai. Natija wahi hai: theory aur experiment taqreeban barabar hain.
Protons, neutrons, hydrogen atoms aur helium atoms se bhi diffraction patterns dekhe gaye hain. Yeh particles ki wave nature ka mazboot proof hai.

Particles ki dual nature par kaam ke liye Prince Louis Victor de Broglie ko 1929 mein physics ka Nobel Prize mila. Clinton Joseph Davisson aur George Paget Thomson ne particles ki wave nature ki experimental confirmation (tajurbe se tasdeeq) par 1937 ka Nobel Prize mil kar liya.

items: de Broglie: λ = h/p = h/mv (18.10); tez kiye electron ke liye λ = h/√(2mVe) (18.11).
Goli ki wavelength bohat chhoti (1 × 10⁻³⁴ m); electron ki X-rays jitni (7 × 10⁻¹⁰ m).
Annihilation ke photons (0.51 MeV): λ = 2.43 pm (Example 18.3).
Davisson-Germer: nickel crystal se electron diffraction; 54 V par λ ≈ 1.66 × 10⁻¹⁰ m, Bragg se 1.65 × 10⁻¹⁰ m.
